subject: Minor clash between mixture models and incomplete detector 'usage'

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Minor clash between mixture models and incomplete detector 'usage'
parts:
Just cross-referencing an obscure phidot post regarding a bug I found in secr.fit(). Mixture models (including hcov) fail (or complete with a convergence error) when the first trap/camera is not used on the first occasion. There are several workarounds: re-order traps or occasions in the input, simply change the first 'usage' value to 1, or collapse occasions with 'reduce'.
Murray
